title: Aspen Search
description: A stark Swiss tile wall: white paper, #232323 ink for text, hairlines, dark tiles and filled buttons, one mint accent (#a1ffcb) for tiles and name bars, flat greys for quiet tiles. Square corners, no shadows, a 450-weight neo-grotesk tracked -4% with a small mono for labels. Dark sibling: the same wall inverted, ink paper and white text, the mint kept.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the original has a light/dark switch whose dark state wasn't captured, so .dark is our inversion in the same spirit
Host Grotesk stands in for Suisse Int'l (closed); Source Code Pro for Suisse Int'l Mono
border is the ink colour on purpose: the grid lines are solid 1px ink
chart-1…5 are the deep client blues (navy, ocean, teal, indigo, steel) used behind client logos
